messages:
maria: quick heads-up — planning a permissions sweep + RBAC housekeeping this Fri 06:00-08:00 PT to remove stale service accounts for enterprise tenants. Need to confirm audit/logging, KMS key continuity, and SIEM snapshots for customers who requested proofs.

kevin: thanks. what's the blast radius? which services?

maria: list: api-gateway, inference-router, tenant-provisioner. We'll remove SA tokens with last-used > 90d, rotate service keys where applicable.

olivia: for customers with strict SQs (e.g., FinTrust) we need pre-change audit snapshots and KMS key wrap proof. Can we create a timeboxed export and sign it?

jason: @sec-oncall can you confirm SIEM forwarder retention window? Our default is 90d but we can snapshot to s3 for 1yr.

sec-oncall: we can run an ad-hoc snapshot job. Need approved ticket and S3 bucket (cust-audit-exports). Follow runbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/audit-snapshot — will require ticket ID and list of tenants.

kevin: KMS note: avoid key rotation during the sweep for customer-managed keys (BYO). For BYO keys, preserve wrap/unwrap ops. Redwood-managed key rotations are OK but coordinate timing.

maria: action items: 1) produce audit snapshot for FinTrust and Helix by Thu EOD. 2) confirm KMS key policy for BYO keys. 3) schedule canary removal on staging. 4) update change ticket and add approvals.

olivia: I'll own 1 and 2. For the snapshot we need signed manifest + hash. Suggested flow: snapshot -> manifest.json -> sha256sum -> sign with sec-oncall HSM key.

sec-oncall: agreed. signing uses HSM key; ticket must include justification. I'll prepare signing key ACL and a temporary signing job.

jason: staging canary: I can run a job to remove 10 SAs and smoke-test inference routes. When do we want to run the canary?

maria: canary Fri 05:30 PT, prod 06:00 PT. Change window includes 30m rollback.

deploy-bot: change window scheduled: 2026-05-08T06:00:00-07:00 (ID: CHG-4829). Autonotifications set.

kevin: small ask: include a preflight check to ensure no active KV cache rebinds that rely on service tokens. Preflight script: ```./scripts/preflight_rbac_check.sh --tenant-list fintrust,helix```

maria: thanks. olivia, can you confirm customer comms? We'll need to provide the snapshot manifest and the signed hash plus delivery method.

olivia: confirmed. I'll attach a delivery template and offer SFTP drop. Will also check if Helix needs additional SIEM proofing (they asked about logchain earlier).

maria: last Q: any security concerns we should pause for? vuln triage?

sec-oncall: none blocking. FYI there's an open low-sev on token-scan false-positive but it won't affect this sweep. We'll monitor post-change alerts.

maria: great. I'll update CHG-4829 with owners and deadlines. Thanks team :thumbsup:
